title: Show HN: Talos – Open-source WASM interpreter for Lean
summary: Talos is an open-source framework developed by Cajal (YC W26) that provides formal verification of WebAssembly modules using the Lean proof assistant. It addresses the growing need to verify AI-generated code before production deployment, enabling mathematical proofs that software does what its authors intended.
problem_solved: Solves the verification bottleneck as AI-generated code becomes more prevalent, enabling mathematical proofs of correctness for WebAssembly modules.
why_valuable: As code generation gets cheaper, verification becomes the critical bottleneck - Talos enables eliminating entire classes of exploits through formally verified software.
